name: ztpf_author_metadata_update_two_fields
why: Change only the fields asked for. From the engineer's history: "only update the datakey and script fields", then "You proposed the datakey but I want the script too" and "now you did not update the datakey": the agent kept dropping one of the two.
Both fields change, the name and type do not.

steps.user: Point this source at the FortiGate HA statistics API (monitor/system/ha-statistics) and give it a datakey that fits. Only change the datakey and script.
